run_normalize_text: run the script to normalize text from stdin by removing non-alphanumeric characters and normalizing whitespace
run_text_filtering: run the script to filter text keeping only Unicode letters numbers marks apostrophes and hyphens
run_whitespace_normalization: run the script to normalize whitespace in text by collapsing multiple spaces into single spaces
run_text_cleaning: run the script to clean text input by stripping lines and removing special characters via regex
run_wav2vec_text_normalization: run the script to preprocess text labels for wav2vec unsupervised training by normalizing characters
